title: ExactOut Swaps Bypass Hook Fees
description: The fee calculation logic in _afterSwap only charges fees when taxableSigned > 0. For exactOut swaps, the input delta is negative (user owes), so taxableSigned will be negative and the fee check fails. This allows sophisticated traders to completely bypass the 0.05% hook fee by routing through exactOut instead of exactIn.
impact: Complete bypass of protocol fee mechanism for exactOut swaps
attackPath: Trader wants to swap with minimal fees
Routes swap through exactOut path instead of exactIn
Fee check fails (taxableSigned <= 0), no fee charged
rootCause: Fee logic assumes positive delta for taxable amount, doesn't handle exactOut correctly
recommendation: Use absolute value of delta for fee calculation, or explicitly handle exactOut swaps with correct sign logic
